Name: Comcast Corp
Description: Comcast Corporation, headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is a leading American telecommunications conglomerate that ranks as the second-largest broadcasting and cable television company globally by revenue. As the largest pay-TV provider and cable TV service operator in the United States, it delivers a comprehensive suite of products to residential and commercial customers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. Additionally, Comcast is the largest home Internet service provider and the third-largest home telephone service provider in the country. The company has expanded its footprint through its ownership of NBCUniversal, which allows it to engage in the production and distribution of premium content for both theatrical and television platforms, positioning itself as a significant player in the media landscape.
